name: @notnotype/nb-workflow
description: Composable script-first Workflow Kernel with replay, optional durable backends, and host ports

scripts.build: bun run clean && bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target node --format esm --sourcemap=external && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/fix-declaration-imports.mjs
scripts.verify:package: bun run build && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit --strict --skipLibCheck false --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext scripts/package-consumer.mts && node scripts/node-smoke.mjs && node scripts/isolated-package-smoke.mjs
